children: Alibaba (BABA) launched Zhenwu V900 AI chip, ~3x faster than M890, clusterable to 500,000 units; mass production aimed Q1 2027. Plans to scale Qwen models to ~5–10T parameters; $53B AI hardware plan.
Alibaba (BABA) plans to invest over $53 billion in AI across three years. Hong Kong shares jumped after the news, retraced slightly, then closed the session higher.
Alibaba (BABA) rolled out three AI products—Smart Studio, Smart Fusion, Smart Video—offering model-as-a-service, multi-model orchestration and AI video tools for enterprise AI deployment and scaling.
Citi says Alibaba (BABA) AI push could boost external cloud revenue to about $160 billion by fiscal 2033, up from a prior forecast of roughly $100 billion for fiscal 2031.
Alibaba (BABA) to add cloud regions in Türkiye, Finland and the Netherlands within 12 months and expand data centers in Malaysia, Germany, UAE, France and Hong Kong.
Alibaba (BABA) trades near fair value as investors price in AI plans while awaiting clearer cloud growth and improved returns on capital.
BABA: Alibaba Cloud partners with Panasonic Digital, Unity China, Lion Parcel, Loomi, SHAKE and AnyMind to boost enterprise AI for automation, game development, logistics and live-commerce.
Alibaba Cloud’s Model Studio (Qwen) was integrated into Unity China’s Tuanjie AI-Codely, adding model-driven AI tools to speed game development workflows using Alibaba Cloud tooling.
